answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so an identity must sustain honest service to retain influence; a brief burst cannot preserve stale trust. In an EigenTrust matrix, a fresh sybil with no credible incoming endorsements has near-zero eigenvector centrality, while reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits collusive links from amplifying it. A comet cannot leap from the trust nadir across a canyon to consensus without durable support.
